_comment: ApexNodes hc-911 (v0.22.2), hc-1203 (v0.23.0): the NousResearch/hermes-agent release this fork last merged. An upstream-sync PR updates tag and commit; diff-based CI gates (code health, supply-chain scan, catalog admission) then also compare against this release, so only what is new against BOTH the fork base and upstream is judged (scripts/ci/upstream_sync_baseline.py). health_allow lists the reviewed union-growth exceptions of THIS sync (upstream growth plus the fork's existing patch in one unit); they apply only while a PR changes this record, so the next sync starts with an empty list.
